snippet.title: Need for Speed Hot Pursuit Limited Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the Edge Day 1 with the Limited Edition

Preorder Need for Speed Hot Pursuit today to secure your copy of the Limited Edition, giving you EXCLUSIVE access to the Alfa Romeo 8C Competizione and the Ford Shelby GT500. 
You'll also receive access to four locked vehicles right out of the box: the Porsche Cayman S and Dodge Challenger SRT8 for your Cop career; the Audi TT RS Coupé and Chevrolet Camaro SS for when you're a Racer.
